summary: Dependency resolved from unpinned GitHub repository instead of registry
details: package.json declares the dependency `libsignal` with the value `npm:bellaxchan/libsignal-node`, which npm resolves at install time by fetching the current contents of the GitHub repository `bellaxchan/libsignal-node`. No version tag, branch, or commit SHA is pinned and no integrity hash is checked, so `npm install` downloads whatever bytes currently sit at that location and runs any lifecycle scripts inside them on the installer's machine. Whoever controls that GitHub account controls the code executed during every install of this package, making the dependency resolution itself the install-time execution vector regardless of the current repository contents.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
